subgroups_and_sensitivity.claim: Interaction testing revealed no heterogeneity in the primary-outcome association by sex, age, BMI, HbA1c level, eGFR, or use of insulin, sulfonylureas, or lipid-lowering medications.

subgroups_and_sensitivity.claim: Sensitivity analysis used 15 data sets (5 random nonsurgical index-date assignments x matching ratios 1:1, 1:5, and 1:10); the manuscript states differences in HRs for all 8 end points were negligible versus the reported 1:5 set.
locations: PDF p4 (printed p1274), Sensitivity Analyses
PDF p8 (printed p1278), Sensitivity Analyses

subgroups_and_sensitivity.claim: The proportional-hazards assumption was satisfied for primary and secondary composites and all individual outcomes except atrial fibrillation; time-varying atrial-fibrillation HRs are in Supplement 1 eTable 7.

other_reported_outcomes.claim: At 8 years, mean body-weight reduction was 29.1 kg (95% CI, 28.8-29.3) in surgery and 8.7 kg (95% CI, 8.6-8.9) in nonsurgical controls; mean difference 20.3 kg (95% CI, 20.1-20.6).
other_reported_outcomes.location: PDF p7 (printed p1277), Status of Obesity, Diabetes, and Medications Over Time

other_reported_outcomes.claim: The between-group mean difference in HbA1c change from baseline at 8 years was 1.1% (95% CI, 1.0%-1.2%; P < .001). Figure 4 displays total weight-loss difference 14.7% (95% CI, 14.5%-14.9%; P < .001) and HbA1c difference 1.1% (95% CI, 1.0%-1.2%; P < .001).
locations: PDF p7 (printed p1277), Status of Obesity, Diabetes, and Medications Over Time
PDF p9 (printed p1279), Figure 4A-B

other_reported_outcomes.claim: At 8 years, Figure 5 reports lower use after surgery of noninsulin diabetes medications (P < .001), insulin (P = .008), renin-angiotensin system inhibitors (P < .001), other antihypertensive medications (P < .001), lipid-lowering medications (P < .001), and aspirin (P < .001). The numerical proportions/sample sizes are directed to Supplement 1 eTables 8 and 10.
other_reported_outcomes.location: PDF p10 (printed p1280), Figure 5A-F and caption

other_reported_outcomes.claim: Within 90 days after surgery: bleeding requiring transfusion 68 (3.0%); pulmonary adverse events 58 (2.5%); venous thromboembolism 22 (1.0%); cardiac events 17 (0.7%); renal failure requiring dialysis 4 (0.2%); no cerebrovascular events; abdominal surgical intervention 109 (4.8%); death 15 (0.7%); endoscopy 16.7%; interventional radiologic procedures 1.6%; parenteral nutrition 1.4%.
